title: Microsoft Sentinel Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on Microsoft Sentinel. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into KQL with pySigma (ASIM, Azure Monitor or Microsoft Defender XDR pipelines) or runs the native KQL query written for Microsoft Sentinel, executes it with the Log Analytics query API over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the Microsoft Sentinel Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Raw events never leave the workspace: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to KQL, or native KQL) on Microsoft Sentinel workspaces and reports sightings, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
